    EmailAddressEndpoints
    Adds the endpoints that let a signed-in person add an email address, or change one, by confirming a link or code sent to it: POST /who/me/email-addresses and POST /who/me/email-addresses/confirmations, and list and remove the addresses: GET /who/me/email-addresses and DELETE /who/me/email-addresses/{id}, under who.base-path, on every browser chain and every stateless chain.

    The caller's linked provider accounts, GET /who/me/accounts and DELETE /who/me/accounts/{id}, on every stateless chain, where an API key or bearer token may list them and unlinking, which only a browser may do, answers 403.
